subject: MAP milestone: Security intake + SOC 2 artifacts — proposed dates & owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightbank.com>, David Liao <david.liao@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP milestone for security intake

Hi Elena / David —

Thanks again for the call today — good coverage on how Redwood would map into BrightBank's latency and compliance constraints. As promised, here is a short post-demo recap and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone specifically for the security review / SOC 2 artifacts so we can keep the procurement window on track. I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (RDW_MAP-BrightBank_security-draft.xlsx).

Summary of today's ask (high level):
- BrightBank security team wants a SOC 2 artifact bundle and completed security questionnaire for vendor onboarding.
- Key evidence areas: encryption/key management, access controls, logging/audit trails, retention & deletion policy, incident response.
- BrightBank procurement would like a target close date to unblock a POC purchase order.

Proposed MAP milestone: Security intake + SOC 2 package
- Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (SOC2 package lead) — marissa@redwood.com
- Owner (BrightBank): David Liao (Head of InfoSec) — david.liao@brightbank.com
- Deliverables: completed BrightBank questionnaire, SOC 2 summary & signed report, evidence index (csv), sample policy docs
- Suggested target for submission to BrightBank: 2026-02-12 (can shift based on your preferred timeline)
- Dependencies: access to procurement portal (for evidence upload), confirmation of KMS architecture to validate key-rotation screenshots

Next steps I propose this week:
1) Elena/David confirm target submission date (we can move to late Feb if you need more time).
2) If you want, Marissa will assemble a minimal SOC2 bundle (summary, SysTrust table, controls mapping) and Ben will share a short recording of the KMS/key-rotation walkthrough.
3) We lock in a 30-min evidence walkthrough the week after submission (owner: David) to clarify any gaps.

Thanks — I can adjust dates once you confirm internal availability.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: RDW_MAP-BrightBank_security-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet - MAP draft)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@brightbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: David Liao <david.liao@brightbank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP milestone for security intake

Ben — thanks for the recap and for sending the draft MAP. Quick notes from our side after a fast check with procurement and our CISO:

- The questionnaire procurement sent earlier is attached (BrightBank_Security_Questionnaire_v0.docx); please complete in-line where possible.
- Our priorities: encryption at rest & in transit (describe key management, rotation cadence), segmentation & role-based access, retention/deletion timelines, and proof of centralized logging with immutable audit trails.
- We're aiming to have the vendor package in our queue by end of Feb; can you bump the suggested submission to 2026-02-26? That gives our legal and procurement teams time to review internally.

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood provides a signed SOC 2 report or only a summary? Procurement typically requires the report or an auditor's letter.

Elena Martinez
Senior IT Procurement Manager, BrightBank
elena@brightbank.com
Attachment: BrightBank_Security_Questionnaire_v0.docx (docx - vendor questionnaire)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightbank.com>, David Liao <david.liao@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-20T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP milestone for security intake

Thanks Elena — that's helpful. Short answers and updates:

- Submission date: 2026-02-26 works for us. I've updated the MAP draft accordingly.
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide a signed SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for customer-sensitive data) and a one-page summary for quick review. I've attached the summary now; we'll route the full report through our security team once we have an NDA/processed vendor form if needed.
- Evidence we will prepare immediately: encryption architecture diagram, KMS key rotation logs (redacted), IAM role list & RBAC matrix, log retention policy, incident response runbook excerpt. Expect these in the evidence index.
- Dependency: we will need an upload path or procurement portal link from BrightBank to deliver the full evidence bundle. If that's not available, we can place artifacts in a restricted Drive folder and share links, but audit teams usually prefer portal ingestion.

Action items I've assigned in the MAP (updated spreadsheet):
- Marissa: assemble SOC2 summary + evidence index. Target: 2026-02-12 (internal readiness) so we have 2 weeks buffer before your 02-26 submission.
- Ben: KMS walkthrough recording & redaction of logs. Target: 2026-02-09.
- BrightBank (David): confirm procurement portal details / preferred delivery method by 2026-01-29.

I'll also add a short checklist for the evidence walkthrough so we can be efficient.

Best,
Ben
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf - 1-page summary)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@brightbank.com>, David Liao <david.liao@brightbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-21T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP milestone for security intake

Thanks — I'll own the SOC2 bundle for this deal. Quick intake and what I'll deliver:

Planned deliverables (first cut):
- SOC 2 one-page summary (already attached by Ben)
- Controls-to-question mapping (to populate the BrightBank questionnaire)
- Evidence index (CSV) listing artifacts + sample filenames + short description
- Supporting documents: encryption architecture diagram, IAM role list (sanitized), logging config snippets, retention policy excerpt, incident response excerpt

Internal timeline (what I'll do):
- 2026-01-29: Initial mapping of BrightBank questionnaire to controls (I will upload mappings to the shared Drive).
- 2026-02-09: Deliver KMS log redactions & sample screenshots (Ben will provide the recording).
- 2026-02-12: SOC2 bundle internal ready (per Ben's buffer) — then we hand over for final packaging for submission on 02-26.

Question for BrightBank: what format do you prefer for the evidence index? CSV (preferred for upload) or an entry-per-artifact in your portal? I've attached a starter file (evidence-index.csv) with examples.

Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: evidence-index.csv (csv - starter index)

From: David Liao <david.liao@brightbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@brightbank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-22T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP milestone for security intake

Marissa / Ben — this looks good and thank you for the clear owners and dates. Quick confirmations from my side:

- Procurement portal: we will use our secure vendor portal (link to follow). Procurement will require CSV upload for the evidence index — CSV preferred.
- Target delivery: 2026-02-26 confirmed for the submission packet; David will schedule the evidence walkthrough the week of 2026-03-01.
- SOC 2 report: procurement accepts a redacted auditor report; please include statement of scope and date range.

I'll confirm the portal link by 2026-01-29. If anything changes on our timeline I'll flag in this thread.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

David Liao
Head of Information Security, BrightBank
david.liao@brightbank.com
